summary: Jones has explicitly called Israeli actions in Gaza a genocide, stating in 2024 that America must stop funding 'the killing' and, in 2026, urging military force, not just sanctions, to end the destruction in Gaza and Lebanon. He has said opposing Israel's 'Zionist intentions' is not anti-semitic. Vote for Peace rates him an Ally in the general election, consistent with his direct challenge to Israeli military action and US complicity.
